ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms input seeds, a reproduction seed and the unbounded-size flag are declared; it does not fuzz anything.
offer: Generate adversarial inputs with a saved seed and bounded resource use. Retaining the seed is what makes a discovered failure a reproducible engineering result.

minimal.reason: List the input seeds used. Without a corpus fuzzing starts blind, so name the seed inputs.

mid.reason: Record the reproduction seed, a fixed value such as 42. A discovered failure must be replayable, so keep the seed.

maximal.reason: Set unbounded input size to false. Unbounded inputs exhaust resources, so cap size.
